description.en: A genius that learns Qigong well though he's really young.
description.zh: 年轻的天才，极大程度地掌握气功运用。

chat.en: He was willing to stand on the front lines. Was it this spirit that made him a genius, or did such talent forge this spirit?
chat.zh: 他甘愿站在前线，究竟是这种精神让他成为天才，还是他的天赋铸就这种精神？

text.en: swiftly enters your lawn and repels all projectiles
text.zh: 快速进入你的草坪，排开所有的弹射物
